title: Garden and Veil
premise: Mara Oyelaran, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps ledgers for the Guild of Impossible Things while hiding a gift the crown has outlawed. When a burned survivor of the royal purge stumbles into the guildhouse carrying a dragon-scale seal, Mara learns the hunt is a pretext for the crown to claim the last dragon-fire and rewrite the memory of an ancient war. Torn between loyalty to the guild that sheltered him and the truth the seal preserves, Mara must choose to speak the forbidden oath aloud, reigniting dragon-fire to burn a false history out of the world's memory. In the end he loses his gift and his guild, but wins a fragile justice no court will ever record.
about_author: Elodie Okonkwo is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing disputed colonial-era records before turning to fantasy. They write stories about what institutions remember, what they burn, and who pays for the difference.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Introduces the guildhouse, its strange inventory, and Mara's secret gift as he records a sword that remembers its kills. Establishes his careful invisibility. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath routine.

chapters.title: Proclamation at the Market Bell
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The crown's hunt for swordspeakers is read aloud; a neighbor with a faint gift is dragged away. Mara burns a page of his own ledger. Emotional beat: fear sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Guildmaster's Silence
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Guildmaster Sefu refuses to expel Mara but forbids him from using the gift, revealing the guild has hidden oath-bound members before. Emotional beat: gratitude laced with suspicion.

chapters.title: A Woman Made of Ash
chapters.summary: Ishola's POV. A burned survivor collapses at the guild door clutching a dragon-scale seal. She speaks a word only swordspeakers know. Emotional beat: desperate hope.

chapters.title: What the Seal Remembers
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The seal shows Mara a vision of the ancient war—dragons and oath-bound fighting beside kings who later betrayed them. Emotional beat: vertigo of a false history.

chapters.title: The Buyer Who Pays in Names
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. A royal informant offers to buy the seal; Mara stalls, and realizes the guildhouse is already watched. Emotional beat: claustrophobia.

chapters.title: Ishola's Testimony
chapters.summary: Ishola's POV. She recounts the purge of her village and how the crown's historians erased it. Mara begins keeping a secret second ledger. Emotional beat: grief becoming purpose.

chapters.title: Oath-Bound Means Bound
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Flashback to his mentor's death and the oath he swore never to speak aloud. The seal's pull grows. Emotional beat: the weight of inherited silence.

chapters.title: The Night the Watch Came
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Royal watch searches the guildhouse; Sefu's forged ledgers save them, but Ishola hides in the memory-vault. Emotional beat: terror and the cost of shelter.

chapters.title: The Memory-Vault
chapters.summary: Ishola's POV. In the vault, Ishola touches an artifact and relives the dragons' last night. She urges Mara to act; he resists. Emotional beat: awe versus self-preservation.

chapters.title: A Fair Price for a Sword
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The guild sells a remembering sword to a sympathetic magistrate, testing whether justice can work within the law. It half-works. Emotional beat: cautious optimism.

chapters.title: The Informant's Ledger
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Mara discovers the informant's own records—evidence the crown manufactured the hunt to locate the seal. Emotional beat: cold anger.

chapters.title: Sefu's Bargain
chapters.summary: Sefu's POV. Sefu secretly negotiates with the crown to surrender Ishola in exchange for the guild's survival. Emotional beat: love of the guild curdling into betrayal.

chapters.title: The Second Ledger Found
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The informant finds Mara's hidden ledger of purges. Mara must flee or fight; he chooses a controlled burn of the guildhouse's records. Emotional beat: sacrifice of his own history.

chapters.title: Flight Across the Salt Flats
chapters.summary: Mara and Ishola's alternating POV. They flee with the seal, pursued by the informant and a crown swordspeaker-hunter. Emotional beat: exhaustion and unlikely trust.

chapters.title: The Village That Forgot
chapters.summary: Ishola's POV. They pass a village whose people cannot remember the purge that emptied it. Mara realizes the crown is rewriting memory itself. Emotional beat: horror at erasure.

chapters.title: The Hunter Veyra
chapters.summary: Veyra's POV. The crown's hunter, herself a suppressed swordspeaker, closes in—told the oath-bound started the ancient war. Emotional beat: righteous certainty.

chapters.title: Ambush at the Ford
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Mara, unable to resist, speaks a half-oath and turns a river to blood-warm mist to escape. Veyra witnesses it. Emotional beat: exhilaration followed by guilt.

chapters.title: What Half an Oath Costs
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The partial oath burns Mara's sword-hand and begins consuming his memories of his mentor. Emotional beat: the gift's terrible price revealed.

chapters.title: Veyra's Doubt
chapters.summary: Veyra's POV. Veyra finds the manufactured evidence of the purge and confronts her orders. Emotional beat: a believer cracking.

chapters.title: The Dragon-Road
chapters.summary: Mara and Ishola's POV. They reach the ancient dragon-road and the last dragon-fire, a guttering flame in a mountain shrine. Emotional beat: pilgrimage awe.

chapters.title: The Keeper of the Flame
chapters.summary: Keeper's POV. An ancient keeper explains the fire only answers a full oath spoken with a true ledger. Emotional beat: solemn instruction.

chapters.title: The Missing Page
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The true ledger requires the page Mara burned in chapter 14—his own guild history. Emotional beat: despair; his sacrifice was the key.

chapters.title: Sefu's Confession
chapters.summary: Sefu's POV. Sefu, having handed Ishola over and found the guild hollowed anyway, sends Mara the surviving guild ledger by a dying courier. Emotional beat: remorse too late.

chapters.title: Ishola in the Iron House
chapters.summary: Ishola's POV. Imprisoned, Ishola refuses to reveal the seal's location under interrogation, reciting erased names aloud. Emotional beat: defiance.

chapters.title: Veyra's Choice
chapters.summary: Veyra's POV. Veyra defects, bringing the crown's campaign plans and a key to the Iron House. Emotional beat: treason as conscience.

chapters.title: The Rescue That Costs a Name
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Mara trades another memory to speak his way past the Iron House wards, freeing Ishola but forgetting his own surname. Emotional beat: identity as currency.

chapters.title: The Informant's End
chapters.summary: Mara and Veyra's POV. The informant corners them; Veyra's oath, spoken for the first time in years, destroys them both's hiding—but kills the informant. Emotional beat: bitter victory.

chapters.title: Assembly of the Erased
chapters.summary: Ishola's POV. Survivors of the purges gather at the dragon-road, each carrying a fragment of testimony. Emotional beat: a community of the unrecorded.

chapters.title: The False History Marches
chapters.summary: Veyra's POV. The crown's army approaches to seize the flame and complete the historical rewrite. Emotional beat: dread of overwhelming force.

chapters.title: The Ledger Assembled
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The survivors' testimonies, Sefu's ledger, and Mara's remembered fragments are bound into one true ledger. Emotional beat: fragile wholeness.

chapters.title: Sefu's Atonement
chapters.summary: Sefu's POV. Sefu arrives to stand as witness against himself, offering his testimony though it damns him. Emotional beat: redemption through surrender.

chapters.title: The Oath Spoken
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Climax begins: before the army and the guttering flame, Mara speaks the full oath with the true ledger open. Emotional beat: terror and transcendence.

chapters.title: Dragon-Fire Remembers
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. The flame roars back to life and burns the false history out of every mind in the valley—including the army's. Emotional beat: apocalyptic catharsis.

chapters.title: The Price of Truth
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The oath consumes Mara's gift entirely; he cannot remember Ishola's face or his own oath. Emotional beat: devastating loss.

chapters.title: What the Army Saw
chapters.summary: Soldier's POV. A rank-and-file soldier, memories restored, refuses to march and turns his company home. Emotional beat: ordinary courage.

chapters.title: The Trial Outside the Law
chapters.summary: Ishola's POV. The survivors convene their own tribunal; Sefu is judged and sentenced to rebuild the records he betrayed, not to die. Emotional beat: mercy as justice.

chapters.title: A New Ledger Opens
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The guild reforms as an open house of record; Mara, giftless, is made its first honest archivist. Emotional beat: quiet rebuilding.

chapters.title: The Last Ember
chapters.summary: Keeper's POV. The dragon-fire settles to a small steady ember, enough to light—never to burn. The keeper names Mara its witness. Emotional beat: humble continuity.

chapters.title: Garden and Veil
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Epilogue: Mara plants a garden over the guildhouse ruins, keeping a veil-draped shrine to the memory he lost. Ishola visits; he doesn't know her, but offers her tea. Emotional beat: peace without wholeness.
